label: On event
description: Fires when a StreamHub domain event is dispatched (plate.*, occupancy.*, perimeter intrusion, stream.*, node.*, …), optionally filtered by room, tags or a predicate.

fields.label: Event
fields.help: Exact name or prefix wildcard (e.g. plate.*). Empty = any.

fields.label: Tags
fields.help: Array; fire when any matches the payload tags.

label: On schedule
description: Fires on an interval / cron (BullMQ repeatable).

fields.label: Every (seconds)
fields.help: Simple interval; used when no cron.

label: On MQTT message
description: Fires on an inbound MQTT topic on the app's broker.

label: Manual / API
description: Fires from the Run button or POST …/run.

label: Snapshot
description: Capture a JPEG frame from a room (uploaded to the app S3).

label: Store to S3
description: Upload an in-memory blob (text/JSON/base64) to the app bucket.

fields.label: Base64
fields.help: Decode content from base64 before upload.

label: HTTP POST
description: POST a mapped JSON body to any URL (SSRF-guarded).

fields.label: Body
fields.help: Templated; defaults to the trigger payload.

label: Analyze with AI
description: Send a prompt (optionally with an image) to OpenAI/DeepSeek and capture the reply — budget-guarded.

label: Emit event
description: Dispatch a streamflow.* event through the app's signed callbacks + MQTT.

label: Publish MQTT
description: Publish a payload to an arbitrary topic on the app's MQTT broker (no-op when MQTT is disabled for the app).

fields.label: Topic
fields.help: Templated; namespaced under the app topic prefix.

fields.label: Payload
fields.help: Templated; defaults to the trigger payload. Objects are JSON-encoded.

label: Call plugin
description: POST an event to another installed plugin's /events channel.

label: Condition
description: Branch true/false on a safe typed comparison over the bag.

label: Set variable
description: Map/transform bag fields into vars for downstream boxes.

label: Switch
description: Route to a port by matching a field against cases.
